extraFacts.fact: Thorburn model codes in the exotic-alloy and stainless listings: 95 is an unbraided core, 96 a single braid and 96Z a double braid in the same alloy.
extraFacts.source: Indus Hydraulics listings for Thorburn hoses (titles and construction fields)

extraFacts.fact: Corrugated metal hose terms: annular corrugation is a series of parallel rings (versus helical, a continuous spiral); braid is a woven wire sleeve that contains pressure; ISO 10380 covers corrugated metal hoses and hose assemblies, with a safety factor of 4:1 on burst pressure as quoted in the listings; hoses are hydrotested at 1.5 times working pressure.
extraFacts.source: ISO 10380 (corrugated metal hoses and hose assemblies); manufacturer listings

faqs.q: What is the Hose Master CGA96 Industrial Argon / Nitrogen Service Hose used for?
faqs.a: A Hose Master corrugated stainless steel hose assembly for industrial gas service — argon, nitrogen or carbon dioxide — built to the bore, length and end connections the installation needs. Typical uses include argon and mixed-gas supply to welding cells, nitrogen blanketing and purge lines and CO₂ supply lines. See the [specialty hose assemblies](/c/metallic-specialty-assemblies).

faqs.q: Hose Master CGA96 Industrial Argon / Nitrogen Service Hose: what is the typical service life and maintenance schedule?
faqs.a: Service life depends on duty cycle and process exposure. Annual inspection recommended. Tell us the application and we check it against the specification.

faqs.q: What should I know before ordering the Hose Master CGA96 Industrial Argon / Nitrogen Service Hose?
faqs.a: Corrugated stainless steel core with stainless wire braid. End connections are chosen for the gas and the equipment it connects to. “CGA96” in a hose description refers to a Canadian Gas Association fuel-gas certification, not an industrial-gas standard; confirm the certification the project needs. Give the full duty on your request for the Hose Master CGA96 Industrial Argon / Nitrogen Service Hose.

faqs.q: Hose Master CGA96 Industrial Argon / Nitrogen Service Hose: what end fittings are used?
faqs.a: CGA-580 / CGA-320 / CGA-540 selectable per service. End-fitting alloy is typically matched to the inner core for severe service. For cryogenic assemblies, vacuum-jacketed bayonet or threaded couplers are standard; for steam-jacketed assemblies, the inner and outer hoses are sealed at independent flanged ports.

faqs.q: What do I send to order the Hose Master CGA96 Industrial Argon / Nitrogen Service Hose?
faqs.a: To order the Hose Master CGA96 Industrial Argon / Nitrogen Service Hose, send the fluid, its pressure and temperature, the bore, overall length, both end connections and any standard or certificate the project needs. We confirm the build and its ratings with the maker before quoting, and supply the test certificate with the assembly.

faqs.q: how does the Hose Master CGA96 Industrial Argon / Nitrogen Service Hose integrate with my system?
faqs.a: Confirm the host system interface on the RFQ — Indus matches the assembly fittings to your installation. Tell us the application and we check it against the specification.

faqs.q: what standards / certifications does the Hose Master CGA96 Industrial Argon / Nitrogen Service Hose meet?
faqs.a: ISO 10380:2012. PED 2014/68/EU Module H. ASME B31.3, Section VIII Div 1. CGA-8.1-M86, CGA96, UL536. EN 10204 3.1 / 3.2 mill test reports.

faqs.q: Where is the Hose Master CGA96 Industrial Argon / Nitrogen Service Hose typically used?
faqs.a: The Hose Master CGA96 Industrial Argon / Nitrogen Service Hose has several listed uses. Listed uses: argon and mixed-gas supply to welding cells; nitrogen blanketing and purge lines; CO₂ supply lines.

Specify the duty (e.g., chlorine rail-loading cart, asphalt steam-jacket header, cryogenic LNG unloading cart) on the RFQ for a complete proposal.

Typical uses include LNG bunkering and tanker transfer and terminal and plant LNG lines. See the [specialty hose assemblies](/c/metallic-specialty-assemblies).

faqs.q: Senior Flexonics Cryogenic LNG Marine Transfer Hose: how is the cryogenic insulation maintained?
faqs.a: The vacuum-jacketed outer hose maintains insulation against ambient heat ingress. A super-insulator (typically multi-layer aluminized mylar) wraps the inner process hose; the outer jacket is evacuated to <10⁻⁵ torr. Re-evacuation is recommended every 18-24 months to maintain rated boil-off performance.

faqs.q: What should I know before ordering the Senior Flexonics Cryogenic LNG Marine Transfer Hose?
faqs.a: Braided corrugated stainless steel hose for cryogenic liquid transfer. Insulation is either a foam cover over the braid or a vacuum jacket; vacuum-jacketed hose is a different, heavier build — say which the duty needs. End connections are matched to the gas so hoses cannot be cross-connected (CGA V-6 for nitrogen, oxygen and argon in North American practice). Give the full duty on your request for the Senior Flexonics Cryogenic LNG Marine Transfer Hose.

faqs.q: What is the Senior Flexonics Steam-Jacketed Chemical Process Hose used for?
faqs.a: A Senior Flexonics steam-jacketed hose : the product runs in an inner metal hose, steam or another heating medium in the outer, keeping viscous or temperature-sensitive chemicals fluid. Typical uses include resin and specialty-chemical transfer, viscous products that set if they cool and heated loading lines. See the [specialty hose assemblies](/c/metallic-specialty-assemblies).

faqs.q: Senior Flexonics Steam-Jacketed Chemical Process Hose: how does the steam-jacket integrate with my system?
faqs.a: The outer steam carrier connects to your steam header at one end and condensate return at the other. The inner process hose has its own independent inlet and outlet flanges. Steam supply pressure is sized to match the desired process temperature — typically 50-150 psi steam for asphalt / pitch service at 200-300°F process temperature.
